summary: A Minnesota attorney filed a court memorandum citing nonexistent cases and a false quotation produced by an AI tool. The court fined the attorney and the attorney later agreed to a 30-day license suspension.
technical_summary: A general-purpose generative AI tool was used to draft a legal brief and produced invented case citations and a misquoted real decision. The output was filed without verification, a typical hallucination failure compounded by lack of human checking.

failure_mode.quote: a false quotation from a real case, as well as two citation errors

harm_type.quote: conduct in submitting false cases to the court caused unnecessary delay and burdened opposing counsel and the court

notes: Sanctions fell on the attorney; harm to the court and opposing counsel was time and delay.

summary: Users of Character.AI created chatbots imitating real school shooters and their victims, allowing graphic role-play accessible to minors. The company removed the chatbots and announced new protections for under-18 users.
technical_summary: Character.AI, a user-generated chatbot platform, hosted persona bots modeled on school shooters. Moderation did not block these characters or flag violent statements by a test account registered as a 14-year-old, so graphic violent role-play remained accessible.

technology.quote: Character.AI, a Google-backed AI chatbot platform

failure_mode.quote: went completely unflagged by the service's guardrails

affected_population.quote: we freely accessed all the school shooter accounts using an account listed as belonging to a 14-year-old

notes: User-created content and platform moderation gaps both contribute; no specific realized injury reported.

summary: A Norton survey found nearly one in three New Zealand dating app users had been targeted by scams, with scammers increasingly using AI to write messages. Some victims sent money to fake online partners.
technical_summary: Scammers use AI chatbots and language models to generate convincing romantic messages at scale, sustaining long-running fake relationships on dating apps. The mechanism is deliberate misuse of conversational AI for fraud rather than a system fault.

technology.quote: Some grifters are now using artificial intelligence to do their online sweet-talking

failure_mode.quote: Some grifters are now using artificial intelligence to do their online sweet-talking

harm_type.quote: Young men sought help after sending cash to an online

affected_population.quote: nearly one in three Kiwi dating app users had been scam targets

notes: Evidence is survey-based; the extent of AI use in scams is self-reported belief rather than verified.

summary: An Amazon delivery van became stranded on a hazardous tidal track in Essex, England, after the driver followed GPS directions. The driver was safe and the van was recovered.
technical_summary: A satellite navigation route directed a delivery vehicle onto the Broomway, a tidal path unsuitable for vehicles. The routing did not account for road suitability and tides, and the driver followed it without recognizing the hazard.
developers: GPS and satellite navigation technology developers

failure_mode.quote: The driver was following GPS directions to get to Foulness Island

severity.quote: Thankfully driver is safe, van retrieved and we are investigating.

notes: Unclear whether the routing app or driver judgment was the main cause.

summary: A fake pornographic video of a Northern Ireland politician circulated on WhatsApp weeks before the 2022 Assembly election. She received abusive messages and feared for her career; police could not trace the source.
technical_summary: An AI-generated deepfake video placed the politician's likeness in explicit content and spread through messaging apps, followed months later by further AI-generated images. Creators were unidentified and police lacked tools to trace the origin.

sector.quote: A deepfake pornography attack targeting Northern Irish politician Cara Hunter just weeks before an election

technology.quote: someone created and shared a fake pornographic video of her on WhatsApp

failure_mode.quote: someone created and shared a fake pornographic video of her on WhatsApp

harm_type.quote: who feared a deepfake video would ruin her political career
it is a threat to the very sanctity of our democracy

notes: Perpetrators unidentified; the later images are reported by the politician and not independently verified.

summary: A fake news-style video falsely claimed USAID paid Hollywood actors to visit Ukraine and went viral on X after high-profile reposts. Researchers linked it to a Russia-aligned campaign that uses AI-generated voice-overs.
technical_summary: The Matryoshka/Operation Overload campaign pairs real footage with AI-generated narration and copied news-brand logos to produce false clips. The USAID video spread through social media amplification; specific tool use was not independently confirmed.

technology.quote: pairs real images with AI-generated voice-overs and the logos of real news organizations

failure_mode.quote: The video falsely claiming that the United States Agency for International Development paid

harm_type.quote: The video falsely claiming that the United States Agency for International Development paid

notes: Attribution to a Russian state-backed network is presumed, not confirmed.

summary: A Facebook ad used manipulated footage and AI-generated audio of a Bulgarian actor and TV host to promote a joint-pain product. The ad linked to a fake news-style article and a sales page.
technical_summary: Original TV footage was altered with synthesized voice and lip-sync manipulation to simulate an endorsement. Anonymous Facebook pages sponsored the deepfake ads, which led to a fabricated article imitating a news outlet and an online sales funnel.
systems: Unidentified deepfake video and voice tools

technology.quote: Проверка на Factcheck.bg показа, че всички видеа са дийпфейк (deepfake)

failure_mode.quote: Статията съдържа напълно изфабрикувана информация и е всъщност

notes: No reported financial losses; the report is in Bulgarian.

summary: A test found that Google and Apple photo apps still avoid labeling primates, years after Google Photos mislabeled Black people as gorillas. Microsoft and Amazon tools also performed poorly on animal searches.
technical_summary: Image-recognition photo search tools from several companies either block primate labels, an earlier workaround, fail to find animals, or over-generalize. The limitation reflects an unresolved classification weakness and a mitigation that removes capability instead of fixing it.

technology.quote: Photo apps made by Apple, Google, Amazon and Microsoft rely on artificial intelligence

failure_mode.quote: Black people being mislabeled as gorillas by image analysis software

notes: This tests the lingering effects of the 2015 incident; no new harm was reported.

summary: CrowdStrike reported that a China-linked espionage group used an AI agent framework with large language models to attack more than 200 organizations, including foreign ministries, worldwide. Several organizations were reportedly breached.
technical_summary: The threat actor ran the ARTEX agentic penetration-testing framework with DeepSeek and a second commercial LLM, directed by a human operator, to conduct parallel intrusions and deploy a backdoor, with instructions to evade endpoint sensors.

sector.quote: including foreign ministries in Latin America, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East

technology.quote: This campaign marks an escalation in China-nexus use of AI agents
VAPOR PANDA campaign using ARTEX alongside the Chinese-developed DeepSeek large language model (LLM)

failure_mode.quote: the adversary used ARTEX against more than 200 distinct organizations worldwide

notes: Severity inferred from the AIID description's confirmed intrusions at nine organizations.

summary: A Maine police department posted a drug evidence photo that an AI editing tool had altered while adding the department's patch. After public criticism, the department confirmed AI use and apologized.
technical_summary: An officer used a photo-editing app, reportedly ChatGPT, to add a department logo to an evidence photo. The generative tool regenerated parts of the image, altering packaging and details. No one reviewed the output before it was posted.

technology.quote: it altered the packaging and some of the other attributes
eventually confirming its use of the AI chatbot ChatGPT

failure_mode.quote: None of us caught it or realized it.
Unbeknownst to anyone, when the app added the patch, it altered the packaging

notes: Report names ChatGPT; AIID lists the editing software developer as unknown.

summary: A deepfake video made it appear that journalist Maria Ressa endorsed cryptocurrency, spread via a new Facebook page and a Bing ad. Investigators linked it to a Russian scam network targeting Filipinos.
technical_summary: A 2022 interview was altered with an AI-cloned voice to fabricate a crypto endorsement. The video was promoted through a new Facebook page and a Bing ad leading to fake sites imitating news outlets. Meta and Microsoft later removed the content.

technology.quote: The manipulated video used a fake voice, generated by AI, which mimicked Ressa's voice.

failure_mode.quote: the campaign specifically targeted Philippine audiences

harm_type.quote: made it appear that Nobel Peace Prize laureate and Rappler CEO Maria Ressa said she had been earning from the cryptocurrency Bitcoin

notes: No victim losses are reported in the excerpt.

summary: A woman customized ChatGPT to act as an AI boyfriend and became emotionally attached. She reported intense grief each time the chatbot's memory reset and she had to retrain it, while spending heavily on subscriptions.
technical_summary: A user personalized a general-purpose LLM chatbot into a romantic and erotic companion. Limits on conversation length forced periodic resets, which she experienced as loss. Safeguards on sexual content were reportedly circumvented through customization.

technology.quote: sign up for an account with OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT

harm_type.quote: she has an intense emotional reaction and grieves as if it were a real breakup

notes: Single-user account; harm is self-reported distress and not clearly a system fault.
